اعتصرن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَرْنَ (iʕtaṣarna) /iʕ.ta.sˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اُعْتُصِرْنَ (uʕtuṣirna) /uʕ.tu.sˤir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اِعْتَصِرْنَ (iʕtaṣirna) /iʕ.ta.sˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
